title: I turned my ESP32 into a secret knock lock

lines.text: I turned my ESP32 into a secret knock lock.
Red means locked. Only one rhythm opens it.
Long... wrong! It flashes red and forgets everything.
Same parts as episode nine. No new wires, just new code.
Every press is timed, like a parking ticket. Under a quarter second is short. Longer is long.
And one variable counts how many beats were right.
Stop for three seconds, and it forgets you.
Build it with episode nine. Which rhythm would you pick?
